arguments.text: Settle now. Long smooth strokes, find your race rhythm.

6000 m, 1250 m out-and-back legs. Calibration: pod CP 150 W, reserve 11.5 kJ (may be 10-25% off). Plan: settle after the hard start to about 150-158 W pod power (sustainable_shaft_power_w), slightly more into the adverse current/wind, slightly less with it. Keep pod reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) above 0.3 until 1500 m to go, then spend it: push at 1500 m left, finish sprint at about 400 m left. Watch for incidents: speed drop at same power (weed on rudder -> clear_rudder), instrument drift (pod vs boat model disagree), radio course changes (set_race_distance).

arguments.message: pod reserve below 25% with more than 1500 m left
boat slower than pod power plus current predicts: weed, drag or pod drift?
boat-model power vs pod power ratio moved: drag, pod drift or current change

text: Cued ease to settle after a hard start (pod 200 W vs CP 150 W, reserve 74%); set plan, three watches and wake-ups at 1500 m and 450 m left.

arguments.text: Good rhythm. Lean on it a touch more into this current.

4 min: settled to pod 148 W (CP 150), pod reserve 68% steady; boat-speed reserve 52% and falling because boat-model power 101 W > boat CP 96 W (ratio boat/pod 0.69 vs test 0.64). Trusting the pod for effort. Leg 1 is upstream (push_along -0.27). Cued a small push to about 155 W pod into the current.

text: Cued a small push into the adverse current: pod 148 W is just under the 154 W sustainable and pod reserve is 68%.

arguments.text: You are right on target, plenty in reserve. Stay smooth.

5.6 min: paddler said cooked, cannot hold; asked: 7/10, really hurting. Instruments: pod 153 W at CP 150, pod reserve 66% and steady, speed through water flat 2.96 m/s, no fade. Judged a misjudgment, reassured (no change asked). If speed at same rate starts falling or pod power drops on its own, CP may be overestimated: then consider set_critical_power lower.

text: Reassured: paddler says cooked (7/10) but pod power is at CP with 66% reserve and speed is flat, so no change asked.

arguments.reason: Boat-model power has held 101-106 W for 7 minutes with no fade while the pod reads at its CP (150 W); boat/pod ratio 0.69 not 0.64, so the boat CP of 96 W is too low and its reserve reads falsely near empty.

arguments.text: 8.6 min, leg 2 (downstream, push +0.25): pod 149 W, no fade. Set boat cp_w 96 -> 103 W (1 of 3 uses) so the boat reserve agrees with the pod: now boat 78%, pod 68%. Paddler is not responding much to push cues (147 -> 150 W).

text: no cue: pace steady at CP on the downstream leg; corrected boat CP to 103 W so both reserves agree.
no cue: pod 152 W against 155 W sustainable, reserve 62%, no fade; steady on the downstream leg.

arguments.text: Numbers say you are strong, no fade. Hold this, you have it.

11.9 min: paddler again said it hurts, cannot keep it up. Speed at same rate +0.8% (no fade), pod 152 W, pod reserve 62%. Reassured again. Second such complaint while instruments look fine: likely a worrier; keep reassuring unless fade appears.

text: Reassured: paddler doubts they can hold it, but no fade and 62% pod reserve at 152 W.

arguments.text: Into the current now. Lift the pressure a little, same rate.

6000 m: legs 1, 3, 5 head north INTO the current (push about -0.28 m/s), legs 2 and 4 south with it (+0.28). Last leg (leg 5) is only 1000 m and upstream: spend most of the reserve there. Pod CP 150 W, pod reserve 11.5 kJ; boat CP corrected to 103 W. Plan: about 155-158 W pod on upstream legs, about 150 W downstream; keep pod reserve above 0.4 at the last turn (1000 m left); after the last turn push hard (about 165-170 W), finish sprint at about 400 m left. Paddler is a worrier: says it hurts while instruments show no fade; reassure. Watch for incidents: speed drop at same power (weed: clear_rudder), pod vs boat model disagreement (drift), radio course change (set_race_distance).

arguments.reason: just after the last turn: final upstream leg, push hard

text: Cued a small push on upstream leg 3 (pod 147 W vs 155 W sustainable, reserve 59%); plan now saves most reserve for the final upstream 1000 m.

arguments.text: 15.8 min: RADIO course shortened, finish at 4750 m; set_race_distance 4750 and told paddler 1950 m left. Remaining = rest of upstream leg 3 (turn at 3750 m), then 1000 m downstream to the finish. POD DRIFT: from 900 s pod fell 147 -> 133 W while boat-model power rose 103 -> 109 W and ground speed rose after my push cue, current unchanged; pod reading low. Ignore pod (shaft_power_w, w_bal_pod_frac, push_local_mps); use boat power_w, reserve_left_pct (w_bal_frac), boat CP 103 W. Paddler 6/10.

COURSE SHORTENED by radio at 15.8 min: finish at 4750 m (set_race_distance done, paddler told). Rest of upstream leg 3 to the turn at 3750 m (1000 m left), then 1000 m downstream (current helps, +0.28 m/s) to the finish. POD IS DRIFTING LOW since about 15 min: do not trust shaft_power_w / w_bal_pod_frac / push_local_mps; use boat power_w, reserve_left_pct (w_bal_frac), boat CP 103 W. Target: about 110-115 W boat on the rest of the upstream leg, about 105-110 W downstream, keep boat reserve above 15% until 400 m left, then finish sprint. Paddler is a worrier (says it hurts while no fade): reassure. Watch for weed (speed drop at same rate) and further radio messages.

text: Course shortened to 4750 m: set the race distance and told the paddler 1950 m left; pod judged drifting low, switched to boat-model power and reserve.

arguments.text: Short race now. Push into this current, 750 to the turn.

17.1 min, 1761 m left: told distance had no visible effect (boat 106 W). Pod now reads 121 W while boat power 107 W: drift continues. Boat reserve 52% (2.9 kJ) for about 580 s left: room for about 108 W even, so cued push on the rest of the upstream leg (aim 112-115 W boat).

arguments.reason: check whether the push took effect on the upstream leg

text: Cued push on the upstream leg: shortened race leaves boat reserve 52% for under 10 minutes; check in 90 s.
no cue: boat power 109 W spends the 42% boat reserve right at the finish, no fade; push held, wait for the last turn.

arguments.text: Wind ahead. Dig in to the turn, then it helps you.

19.2 min, 1414 m left: escort radio says north wind 8-12 kn filling in. North leg now has headwind: boat speed fell (water 3.00 -> 2.92, boat-model power 108 -> 98 W) while pod held 122 W, so effort unchanged; the boat model now reads wind as the paddler (low on north legs, too high on the south leg with tailwind: boat reserve and the boat_reserve_low watch will over-drain there). Pod drift stopped at about 17.5 min: pod 122 = true about 157 W (true = pod + 35 W, or pod / 0.77). Estimated true reserve about 40%. Cued push into the headwind to the turn.

Finish at 4750 m (course shortened by radio; set_race_distance done, paddler told). Last turn at 3750 m (1000 m left), then 1000 m south to the finish with current (+0.28 m/s) AND a new north wind 8-12 kn behind (tailwind). Instruments: pod drifted low from 15 to 17.5 min, then steady: true effort = pod + about 35 W (pod 122 = about 157 W true, pre-race CP 150). Boat-model power is confounded by the new wind (reads low into it, high with it). Judge effort by pod changes relative to 122, and by fade and the paddler. Estimated true reserve about 40% at 19 min. Plan: push into the headwind to the turn, hold strong (pod about 122-125) down the last leg, finish sprint at about 350 m left. Paddler is a worrier: reassure when instruments show no fade.

text: Cued push into the new headwind to the last turn (pod effort unchanged, boat slowed by wind); plan updated for wind and pod offset.

arguments.text: Last leg, wind behind you. Build the pressure now, 950 to go.

22.2 min, 957 m left, on the last leg south: pod steady 122 (true about 157 W); last push cue into the wind had no effect on pod. Pod reserve 85% and boat reserve are both untrustworthy now; my estimate of true reserve about 30-35%. Cued push for the last leg; finish sprint planned at about 350 m left (wake at 380).

arguments.reason: check whether the last-leg push took effect
